title: Credit Risk Model & Early Warning Dashboard
subtitle: Probability of Default, Cost-Based Cut-offs & SHAP Explanations
description: An end-to-end credit scoring model that decides whether to approve, review or reject a borrower, and flags existing borrowers before they default. Built on 150,000 borrowers from the public Give Me Some Credit dataset.
highlights: Logistic regression scored 0.854 test AUC against XGBoost's 0.861 — close enough that a bank can choose a fully transparent scorecard.
Cut-off chosen by business cost rather than accuracy: flags 10.8% of borrowers and cuts expected cost by 36.2% versus approving everyone.
Risk grades A–E separate cleanly — 1.1% actual default in grade A rising to 36.8% in grade E, where 10% of borrowers hold ~55% of defaults.

title: Bacterial Image Classification
subtitle: ConvNeXt vs ResNet-50 on the DIBaS Microscopy Dataset
description: A deep learning system that classifies microscopic bacterial images by morphology, structure and staining across 33 bacterial species, built as my final-year thesis at Universitas Sriwijaya.
highlights: Two convolutional architectures — ConvNeXt and ResNet-50 — trained with transfer learning and compared on the DIBaS benchmark dataset.
Predictions are served through a web interface with a confidence floor, so a low-certainty image is refused rather than guessed.
Each species is returned with a plain-language description, making the output readable by lab staff rather than only by the model's author.
code_snippet:
def predict_bacteria(self, image):
    start_time = time.time()
    processed_image = self.preprocess_image(image)
    label, probability, _ = self.model_handler.predict(processed_image)
    execution_time = time.time() - start_time

    # Below the confidence floor, refuse to answer rather than guess
    if probability < 0.5:
        return None, None, execution_time

    return label, probability, execution_time

title: Digital Document Approval System
subtitle: Role-Gated Workflow Across 8 Manufacturing Divisions
status: Deployed at PT Sumatera Prima Fibreboard
description: A document routing and approval platform built in a 2-person team to replace paper memo circulation between 8 manufacturing divisions, cutting the approval cycle from about a week to 2–3 days.
highlights: Approval endpoints are role-gated — only Manager and Standardization roles can act on a document, enforced server-side rather than hidden in the UI.
Every decision, comment and status change is written to an audit trail, so a stalled document can be traced to the division holding it.

title: Vehicle Route Tracking System
subtitle: Checkpoint Transit Logging & Interactive Route Playback
status: Deployed at PT Sumatera Prima Fibreboard
description: A tracking application monitoring 10–20 company trucks per day across 4 checkpoints, turning informal radio check-ins into structured records of departure time, trip duration and stop locations.
highlights: Trips are looked up by ticket ID and replayed on an interactive Leaflet map, with start and end capture images stored alongside each record.
Gave logistics managers real departure and dwell-time data in place of estimates, improving visibility across the factory gates.

title: ALC Learning — Learning Management System
subtitle: Grades, Attendance & Exercises for ~600 Students
description: A Learning Management System built and deployed for Alpha Omega Learning Center, supporting academic assessments, daily exercises and learning modules, and tracking daily grades for around 600 students.
highlights: Production system built with Express.js and a relational database, maintained through testing, deployment and ongoing iteration.
The open companion build adds teacher authentication, class grouping, quiz and bonus scoring, attendance records and a class leaderboard.
Row-level security scopes every query to the signed-in teacher, so one teacher cannot read another's students.
